blurb: Davey's Locker provides deep sea fishing trips of various lengths including half-day, 3/4 day, overnight, and multi-day trips. They also offer whale watching cruises from Newport Harbor and six-pack boat rentals for sportfishing. Trips target a variety of fish species and include experienced captains and crews, with fishing gear and tackle available for rent or included depending on the trip.
